testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect assembly opening modes and cancels: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:405:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect assembly opening modes and cancels ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a recent assembly is displayed in List View ✔ And no recent-document checkboxes are selected ✔ When the user opens the assembly row's actions menu ✔ Then the menu offers Open Express ✔ When the user chooses Open with options ✔ Then File Open Options shows Full as the opening mode ✔ And the dialog shows Model State, Design View and Position View fields ✔ And Skip all unresolved files is unchecked ✔ When the user changes the opening mode to Express ✔ Then the opening mode shows Express ✔ And the Design View and Position View fields are disabled ✔ When the user cancels the dialog ✔ Then the dialog closes and the Recent list is visible
